crime: During open hours, {WITCH_NAME} and a girl often rehearsed apologies privately in a single cell. One day, the girl asked for their usual rehearsal and handed her the phone, asking her to read the message the girl meant to answer. Facing the barred doorway, the girl asked whether the apology sounded sincere. Her answer received no acknowledgment; the girl kept watching the empty doorway.
The intended recipient appeared in the doorway. The girl stood, turned fully toward the newcomer, and reached one hand backward for the phone without looking back. s’s waiting hand.

At lockdown, the intended recipient’s cellmate saw the girl reply to a goodnight greeting and carry the intact phone into the single cell. A guard locked the cell from the outside. The witness then entered her assigned cell with the intended recipient, and a guard locked them in together.

Before morning unlock, the witness looked through the bars and saw only the girl’s body inside. A narrow rectangular band across the face had been crushed inward. The shattered phone lay beside the head, with blood and hair caught along one long edge. Blood spray reached the exterior lock, where an unbroken, unsmeared filament crossed the seam in the still-closed lock that would move when the lock opened.

The wound matched the phone’s long edge, proving the phone had struck the girl. Because the brain injury was immediately fatal, the blow must have come after the witness saw the girl locked in alive; locked elsewhere, the intended recipient could not have wielded it. The intact filament showed that the exterior lock had stayed closed through the strike, since opening the exterior lock at or after the strike would have broken or smeared the filament. Because no one else was in the locked cell at discovery, no ordinary attacker could have struck the girl and then left.

After the body was found, the intended recipient reported seeing {WITCH_NAME} lift the phone with one hand clenched around it during the blind handoff. That was the charging act. Once the charged phone and the girl shared the cell, she commanded its release: the phone flew at the girl’s head and struck once, delivering the fatal blow.
fields.epitaph: Her hands never close; the faceless fist keeps falling.
fields.epithet: The First Listener Nobody Looks Back At
execution: An upright restraint faces a single fist-shaped ram with no human form or face behind it. Before it moves, forearm clamps pin both arms flat against the restraint and hold both hands open.
The ram strikes her chest, then the same spot again and again. The blows drive broken ribs into her lungs and heart. It continues until her chest is crushed and her breathing and circulation stop.

magic.name: Homing Blow
magic.text: She can bind a crushing blow to an object and make it strike a chosen target on command.
